name: AbsGS
tagline: Replaces signed-mean gradient densification with the absolute (per-pixel) image-space gradient magnitude.
diff_from_baseline: Ye et al. 2024, AbsGS (arXiv:2404.10484). Uses |grad| (no sign cancellation across views) so under-reconstructed regions accumulate signal; otherwise the standard 3DGS clone/split/prune loop on Mip-NeRF 360.

name: Taming + AbsGS + RevSplit
tagline: Stacks AbsGS, Taming-3DGS max-grad blending, and the Revised-Densification split-opacity rule on the same densifier.

key_hyperparams.name: revised_opacity
key_hyperparams.role: Rota Bulo et al. 2024 split rule

diff_from_baseline: AbsGS (Ye et al. 2024) + Taming-3DGS (Mallick et al. 2024, arXiv:2406.15643) + Revised Densification (Rota Bulo et al., ECCV 2024). Mean+max grad catches view-specific spikes; revised split keeps cumulative alpha invariant.

name: EDC + Taming + AbsGS
tagline: On top of Taming+AbsGS, adds EDC long-axis deterministic split and recovery-aware pruning after each opacity reset.
pseudocode:
1. Accumulate AbsGS gradients; track mean and per-view max ($g = 0.7\,\bar g + 0.3\,g_{\max}$).
2. Every refine_every steps, mark Gaussians with $g > \tau_g$.
3. If small: clone. If large: long-axis split — children at $\mu \pm 0.5\,s_{\max}\hat e_{\max}$, longest scale $/{1.6}$, $\alpha_{\text{child}}{=}0.6\,\sigma(\alpha_{\text{par}})$.
4. Prune Gaussians with $\sigma(\alpha)<\tau_o$ (or oversize after first reset).
5. At step $k\!\cdot\!T_{\text{reset}}+300$ (recovery-aware): also prune any with $\sigma(\alpha)<0.05$ — overfit ones never recover.
6. Reset opacity every $T_{\text{reset}}=3000$.
7. Stop densification at iter 22k.

key_hyperparams.name: recovery_offset
key_hyperparams.role: iters after reset for early prune

diff_from_baseline: Deng et al., EDC (arXiv:2411.10133), stacked on the local Taming-3DGS-Abs base. Replaces stochastic covariance-sampled split with deterministic long-axis split and adds opacity-reset-aware early pruning.
